name: Worth a Reply
subtitle: Let Jev read your niche and hand you the posts worth replying to today.
summary: Searches recent public posts on a topic and reads every one of them, then sorts them into three lanes: Read, the ones worth your time, Skim, the maybes, and Pass, which stays greyed out and is never listed unless you ask for it. The Read posts come back ordered by how much room there is to add something in a reply, each with its link, one line on why it is worth a reply and an angle you could take. It reads the words of a post and never who wrote it, so it is a call on the writing and not a rating of a person. Nothing is drafted or sent unless you ask.
howToAsk: What should I reply to in AI agents today?
Find me 5 posts worth replying to about indie SaaS
Anything worth replying to on coding agents this week?
provide: a topic, and optionally how many days back (1 to 7).
get: the posts worth a reply, each with a link, one line on why and an angle, then the Skim list.
chips: 2 credits on the API and CLI
Judges the text, never the author
